plugin.name: Psi-Ops Widescreen Fix
ResX.description: Width in pixels. Zero selects the desktop resolution. Restart required.
ResY.description: Height in pixels. Zero selects the desktop resolution. Restart required.
FixHUD.description: Correct the proportions and horizontal placement of the HUD for widescreen. Restart required.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected camera field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Applies to the next camera update.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the publisher, middleware and legal movies at startup. Story movies still play. Restart required.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Resets this page to its defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply settings.
menu.FOVFactor.help: Changes the camera width. 1.0 keeps the original framing.
menu.FixHUD.help: Corrects HUD proportions and placement. Restart the game to apply.
menu.SkipIntro.help: Skips startup logos. Story movies still play. Restart the game to apply.
